# SSGOI quick start for Next.js

SSGOI adds page transitions without replacing your application router.
This quick start assumes Next.js App Router. Use the existing router and page files.

Current version: `@ssgoi/core@7.5.0-beta.0` (npm tag `beta`). All `@ssgoi/*` packages release together.
This beta reads your router through `<Ssgoi framework>` and imports `SsgoiLayoutBoundary` from the root `@ssgoi/react` entry.

## Install

```bash
npm install @ssgoi/react@7.5.0-beta.0
```

## Add one provider and the layout boundary

```tsx
// app/ssgoi-provider.tsx
"use client";

import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { usePathname, useSelectedLayoutSegments } from "next/navigation";
import { Ssgoi, SsgoiLayoutBoundary, type SsgoiFramework } from "@ssgoi/react";
import { drill } from "@ssgoi/react/view-transitions";

const config = {
  transitions: [{ on: "/**", except: "/", transition: drill() }],
};

const framework: SsgoiFramework = {
  useRoute: ({ parallelRoutesKey = "children" }) => {
    const pathname = usePathname();
    const selectedSegments = useSelectedLayoutSegments(parallelRoutesKey) ?? [];
    return pathname == null ? null : { pathname, selectedSegments };
  },
};

export function SsgoiProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <main style={{ position: "relative", zIndex: 0, minHeight: "100dvh", overflowX: "clip" }}>
      <Ssgoi config={config} framework={framework}>
        <SsgoiLayoutBoundary>{children}</SsgoiLayoutBoundary>
      </Ssgoi>
    </main>
  );
}
```

In app/layout.tsx, wrap the existing children with SsgoiProvider inside body.
Keep one provider above the routed region. `SsgoiLayoutBoundary` calls
`framework.useRoute`, keys by the returned pathname, and supplies the transition
marker and URL-hook Suspense handling (`null` renders its `fallback`). It throws
if `<Ssgoi>` has no `framework`.
Define `config` and `framework` at module scope so they stay stable.
Use overflow-x: clip rather than hidden so the wrapper does not become a scroll container.

Verify a link navigation and browser Back: the page should animate in and out.
For persistent headers or tabs, follow the nested-layout guide before changing boundary keys.

`SsgoiRouteBoundary` from `@ssgoi/react/nextjs` still works but is deprecated
and will be removed in 8.0.0.

| --- | --- |
